description: MainActivity.kt defines the main entry point for a Tic Tac Toe Android app, building a UI programmatically without XML. It manages game state, user interactions, display updates, and game logic, including win/draw detection and score tracking.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity is the single-screen activity for the Tic Tac Toe game, handling UI setup, user interaction, game logic, and score management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, constructing the UI components and setting up event listeners.

methods.name: dp
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels for consistent sizing across screens.

methods.name: onCellClicked
methods.description: Handles user taps on game board cells, updating game state, checking for wins/draws, and updating UI.

methods.name: togglePlayer
methods.description: Switches the current player between X and O.

methods.name: disableBoard
methods.description: Disables all game board cells to prevent further moves after game over.

methods.name: enableBoard
methods.description: Enables all game board cells to allow moves.

methods.name: updateScore
methods.description: Updates the on-screen scoreboard to reflect current scores.

methods.name: scoreString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string showing current game scores.

methods.name: resetBoard
methods.description: Clears the game board and optionally resets scores, reinitializing game state.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Checks the current board for a winner or a draw; returns the result.
